_about: Images for the demo company's website, made with Google Gemini by scripts/gemini_images.py. Jobs run in this order; finished ones are skipped. 'reference' is sent with the prompt so the result keeps the object's exact colors and shape. Hilda & Luna Beadworks is fictional.
style: Photorealistic product photography, natural soft studio light, shallow depth of field, warm slightly muted colors, fine film grain. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people's faces.
product_style: Turn this 3D render into a photorealistic macro product photo of the same object: keep exactly the same colors, shape, pattern, number of pieces and their arrangement. Handmade lampwork glass or cast pewter, with real material detail (tiny bubbles and glossy reflections in glass, fine casting texture in metal). Lying on warm off-white paper, soft studio light from the upper left, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field. Same camera angle and framing as the render.

jobs.name: hero-strand
jobs.prompt: Turn this 3D render into a photorealistic flat-lay photo of the same handmade necklace: the same glass beads in the same order and colors, strung on a waxed linen cord, with the gold crescent-moon-and-star charm hanging at the bottom. On warm natural linen, soft window light from the left, editorial jewelry photography.

jobs.name: collection-amber-hollow
jobs.prompt: Three-quarter overhead view of handmade lampwork glass beads in warm amber, rust orange and deep forest green, scattered on a dark walnut table, with a few small antique-bronze pewter charms shaped like acorns, mushrooms and a crescent moon, and two dry oak leaves. Low late-afternoon window light from the left. Keep the top third darker and uncluttered.

jobs.name: collection-coastal-garden
jobs.prompt: Three-quarter overhead view of handmade lampwork glass beads in blush pink, seafoam mint, pale butter yellow and periwinkle, scattered on pale natural linen, with a few small polished silver charms shaped like scallop shells and leaves, and a sprig of sea lavender. Bright, airy morning light. Keep the top third soft and uncluttered.

jobs.name: story-workshop
jobs.prompt: Close-up of an artisan's hands at a lampworking torch, winding a glowing molten orange glass bead onto a steel mandrel. Jars of colored glass rods on a small workbench, a dark background, warm light from the flame. Documentary style; hands and forearms only.

jobs.name: social-background
jobs.prompt: Wide flat-lay of handmade lampwork glass beads (deep blue with teal dots, opal swirl, terracotta, forest green lentils, faceted sand-colored) and small gold and silver charms (a crescent moon with a star, a bee, a lotus) on warm cream linen. All objects are on the right half; the left half is empty, softly lit linen for a title. Editorial product photography.
